newsitem.title: USA: ComEd Byron 2 Ill. nuke at 12 pct power.
newsitem.headline: ComEd Byron 2 Ill. nuke at 12 pct power.

text.p: Commonwealth Edison's 1,105 megawatt (MW) Byron 2 nuclear unit was operating at 12 percent power and preparing to synchronize to the grid Thursday morning, the Nuclear Regulatory Commission (NRC) said.
The unit had been shut since Saturday for maintenance.
The adjacent unit, with an identical generating capacity, was operating at full power, the NRC plant status report stated. Both units are located in Byron, Ill.
ComEd is a subsidiary of Unicom Corp.
